scripts.build: npm run build:product && npm run build:desktop
scripts.check:workspaces: npm run typecheck && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:product
scripts.check: npm run desktop:verify && npm run check:workspaces && npm run check:desktop && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.desktop:install: npm run install:web -w @futurestaff/fs-geo && corepack yarn@4.18.0 --cwd desktop-shell install --immutable
scripts.release:profile: npm run build -w @futurestaff/fs-core && npm run build -w @futurestaff/fs-platform-access && npm run build -w @futurestaff/fs-product-hub-ui && npm run build -w @futurestaff/douyin-dm-mcp && npm run build -w @futurestaff/fs-douyin-ui && npm run build -w @futurestaff/fs-geo && npm run build -w @futurestaff/fs-video && node scripts/stage-release-profile.mjs
scripts.profile:dump:release: npm run release:profile && cross-env DSH_HOME=dist/desktop-profile NODE_OPTIONS=--import=./scripts/load-env.mjs dsh --profile futurestaff-alpha --dump-config
scripts.installer:runner:windows: npm run package:runner:windows && npm run compile -w @futurestaff/local-runner-installer
scripts.douyin:profile: npm run build -w @futurestaff/fs-core && npm run build -w @futurestaff/douyin-dm-mcp && node scripts/install-douyin-profile.mjs
scripts.predesktop:dev: npm run release:profile && corepack yarn@4.18.0 --cwd desktop-shell workspace dsh-community-market build && corepack yarn@4.18.0 --cwd desktop-shell workspace dsh-plugin-desktop build
